summary: Alto Ingredients filed a prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $50 million of common stock through agents Craig-Hallum, Benchmark, and H.C. Wainwright. The company may sell shares from time to time at prevailing market prices; last sale on August 4, 2026 was $5.29 per share. Agents receive 3.0% of gross proceeds. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal terms apply. What to watch: potential dilution from ATM sales and market impact on ALTO shares.
